class.name: NetwReparentOpts
class.description: Carries what a move needs beyond its destination. [member target_global_position] is a [Variant] rather than a vector because unset and origin are different requests: leaving it unset moves the entity without touching its pose, while setting it to a zero vector asks for the world origin. [codeblock] var opts := NetwReparentOpts.new() opts.target_global_position = door.global_position NetwEntity.of(self).reparent_to(next_room, opts) [/codeblock]

members.member: Optional gameplay label for the reparent.

Destination world pose applied to [member Node.owner] before the parent swap, so re-init driven by [signal NetwEntity.reparented] (interpolator reset, camera smoothing) baselines on the final position instead of the pre-move one. Unset ([code]null[/code]) leaves the owner where it is.
